i.norm:
Verifies that a thresholded LevenshteinDistance returns -1 when the actual edit distance exceeds the threshold.

The threshold is first derived from an unlimited comparison of a sequence with itself (distance 0). Re-using that 0 as the threshold for a second comparison of two sequences that differ in one character (actual distance 1) forces the limited algorithm to give up and return -1.
A two-char sequence ")�" and an all-zero two-char sequence "��".
The default instance has no threshold; comparing a sequence with itself yields 0.
Use that 0 as the threshold. The two sequences differ in their first character (actual distance 1 > threshold 0), so the limited algorithm returns -1.
